module: Processes two families of active parts: license plates and skins. A part with a slotType containing '_licenseplate' (or having licenseplateFormat) activates the plate; the formats used are collected (default '30-15'). A plate design part (slotType containing 'licenseplate_design') provides licenseplate_path. A skin part (slotType containing 'skin_' or equal to 'paint_design') calls vehicleObj:setSkin("<slot>.<skin name>") and can impose default colors. At the end, if a plate is used, core_vehicles.setPlateText is called.
notes: The skin name is part.skinName, otherwise part.globalSkin, otherwise empty string; the skin slot is part.skinType (if non-empty string) otherwise the slotType; 'paint_design' or a non-string slotType gives an empty prefix.
The default colors (part.default_color, default_color_2, default_color_3) are sent via core_vehicle_manager.setVehicleColorsNames.
The plate text comes from config.licenseName, otherwise false (the manager generates the text).
slotType can be a string or a table of strings.

process.desc: Walks the active parts to configure the vehicle's license plate and skins.
